style: Modern, high-pressing, possession football under Julian Nagelsmann. Built around a creative Musiala-Wirtz axis, Germany combine quick positional rotations, vertical passing and aggressive counter-pressing. Joshua Kimmich orchestrates from a deep midfield role.
recent_form: Younger and more technically exciting than in recent cycles, carrying momentum from a strong Euro 2024 on home soil. Concerns center on Jamal Musiala's fitness after a serious injury, though Nagelsmann insists he remains world-class even below peak.

key_players.name: Jamal Musiala
key_players.note: Bayern Munich's 23-year-old dribbler; Germany's most unpredictable attacker. Returning from serious injury, his form could define how far they go.

key_players.name: Florian Wirtz
key_players.note: Liverpool playmaker at his first World Cup; among the best attacking mids in the world, scored the opening goal of Euro 2024.

key_players.name: Joshua Kimmich
key_players.note: Bayern leader who anchors midfield and sets tempo; versatile enough to fill full-back if needed.

key_players.name: Kai Havertz
key_players.note: Arsenal forward offering hold-up play, movement and goal threat as the focal point of the attack.

key_players.name: Manuel Neuer
key_players.note: 40-year-old reversed retirement for his fifth and final World Cup; sweeper-keeper experience but mobility/age a risk.

key_players.name: Nick Woltemade
key_players.note: Newcastle's tall striker provides an aerial Plan B and depth up front.

historical_news: Four-time World Champions (1954, 1974, 1990, 2014), one of the most decorated nations in the sport.
Won the 2014 World Cup in Brazil, including the historic 7-1 semifinal demolition of the hosts.
Shock group-stage exits at both the 2018 and 2022 World Cups marked a prolonged decline for the Nationalmannschaft.
Resurgence narrative built on the Musiala-Wirtz generation that lit up Euro 2024 on home soil under Nagelsmann.
Manuel Neuer's surprise return from retirement at age 40 for a fifth World Cup became a major storyline.
Pressure on Nagelsmann to restore Germany to the elite after consecutive tournament humiliations.

media_sentiment.label: positive
media_sentiment.summary: Optimism around a youthful, exciting attack and Euro 2024 momentum, tempered by anxiety over Musiala's fitness and an aging Neuer in goal.
